summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Plutus Predict Astrology system. All backend APIs (7/7) working perfectly. Frontend astrology features fully functional with curated predictions, reconciliation, and proper UI display. System successfully matches astrology predictions with real disaster data from USGS/NOAA/GDACS.
passed_tests: GET /api/astrology/curated - Returns 23 curated predictions from 4 channels
POST /api/astrology/load-curated - Loads predictions to MongoDB successfully
GET /api/astrology/imported-predictions - Returns 26 stored predictions with proper structure
POST /api/astrology/reconcile - Matches predictions with disaster data (6 matches found)
POST /api/astrology/admin/add-prediction - Admin can add new predictions
GET /api/astrology/admin/predictions - Admin can list all predictions
Frontend Astrology page - LOAD_PREDICTIONS button works correctly
Frontend displays predictions with categories (8 WAR, 7 EARTHQUAKE, 5 DISASTERS, 4 METALS)
AI RECONCILED tab shows matched predictions with actual earthquake events
Reconciliation system matches astrology predictions with USGS earthquake data
Source channels tab displays all 4 tracked astrologers
Statistics display correctly (4 CHANNELS, 26 PREDICTIONS, 6 RECONCILED)
Curated predictions from Abhigya Anand, Prashant Kapoor, Ashish Mehta, Preetika Rao
Prediction categories properly color-coded and categorized
Navigation between astrology tabs (EXTRACTED PREDICTIONS, AI RECONCILED, SOURCE CHANNELS)
